mapper.select: /* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvlCnsttnUpdate - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR ,EVL_GROUP_SE_CD AS EVL_GROUP_SE_CD ,EVL_TME_SE_CD AS EVL_TME_SE_CD ,BGNG_YMD AS BGNG_YMD ,END_YMD AS END_YMD ,PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,CHTT_WGHTVA_VALUE *100 AS CHTT_WGHTVA_VALUE ,NTABRD_WGHTVA_VALUE *100 AS NTABRD_WGHTVA_VALUE ,MSNGR_WGHTVA_VALUE *100 AS MSNGR_WGHTVA_VALUE ,PRFMNC_WGHTVA_VALUE *100 AS PRFMNC_WGHTVA_VALUE ,EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN FROM AYC200 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoMngBassInfo - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_TME_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_TME_SE_CD) AS EVL_TME_SE_CD --평가회차그룹코드 ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_GROUP_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_GROUP_SE_CD) AS EVL_GROUP_SE_CD --평가그룹구분코드 ,BGNG_YMD AS BGNG_YMD ,END_YMD AS END_YMD ,PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,CHTT_WGHTVA_VALUE AS CHTT_WGHTVA_VALUE ,NTABRD_WGHTVA_VALUE AS NTABRD_WGHTVA_VALUE ,MSNGR_WGHTVA_VALUE AS MSNGR_WGHTVA_VALUE ,PRFMNC_WGHTVA_VALUE AS PRFMNC_WGHTVA_VALUE ,EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN FROM AYC200 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoMngInfoList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT T1.PRVSON_NM ,T1.CHTT_BGNG_YMD ,T1.CHTT_END_YMD ,T1.NTABRD_BGNG_YMD ,T1.NTABRD_END_YMD ,T1.MSNGR_BGNG_YMD ,T1.MSNGR_END_YMD ,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN ,T1.RLVT_YR FROM AYC200 T1 WHERE T1.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ) SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '01' THEN '채팅' WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '02' THEN '게시판' WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '03' THEN '메신저' WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '04' THEN '실적' END AS EVL_PRVSON ,CASE WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '01' THEN DECODE(CHTT_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'',SUBSTR(CHTT_BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CHTT_BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CHTT_BGNG_YMD,7,2) || '~' || SUBSTR(CHTT_END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CHTT_END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CHTT_END_YMD,7,2)) WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '02' THEN DECODE(NTABRD_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'',SUBSTR(NTABRD_BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(NTABRD_BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(NTABRD_BGNG_YMD,7,2) || '~' || SUBSTR(NTABRD_END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(NTABRD_END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(NTABRD_END_YMD,7,2)) WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '03' THEN DECODE(MSNGR_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'',SUBSTR(MSNGR_BGNG_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(MSNGR_BGNG_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(MSNGR_BGNG_YMD,7,2) || '~' || SUBSTR(MSNGR_END_YMD,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(MSNGR_END_YMD,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(MSNGR_END_YMD,7,2)) WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) = '04' THEN '실적' END AS EVL_PRD ,REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) AS PIVOT_COL ,CHTT_BGNG_YMD AS CHTT_BGNG_YMD ,CHTT_END_YMD AS CHTT_END_YMD ,NTABRD_BGNG_YMD AS NTABRD_BGNG_YMD ,NTABRD_END_YMD AS NTABRD_END_YMD ,MSNGR_BGNG_YMD AS MSNGR_BGNG_YMD ,MSNGR_END_YMD AS MSNGR_END_YMD ,EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR FROM DUAL,TMP WHERE REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) != '04' CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(TMP.PRVSON_NM,'[^,]+',1,LEVEL) IS NOT NULL

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoAdding - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT CHTT_BGNG_YMD AS CHTT_BGNG_YMD ,CHTT_END_YMD AS CHTT_END_YMD ,NTABRD_BGNG_YMD AS NTABRD_BGNG_YMD ,NTABRD_END_YMD AS NTABRD_END_YMD ,MSNGR_BGNG_YMD AS MSNGR_BGNG_YMD ,MSNGR_END_YMD AS MSNGR_END_YMD ,PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,DECODE(CHTT_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'','Y') AS chk1 ,DECODE(NTABRD_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'','Y') AS chk2 ,DECODE(MSNGR_BGNG_YMD,NULL,'','Y') AS chk3 FROM AYC200 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoAbilitMngBassInfo - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_TME_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_TME_SE_CD) AS EVL_TME_SE_CD --평가회차그룹코드 ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_GROUP_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_GROUP_SE_CD) AS EVL_GROUP_SE_CD --평가그룹구분코드 ,PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN FROM AYC200 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoCrtrMngBassInfo - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_TME_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_TME_SE_CD) AS EVL_TME_SE_CD --평가회차그룹코드 ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EVL_GROUP_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = EVL_GROUP_SE_CD) AS EVL_GROUP_SE_CD --평가그룹구분코드 ,PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN FROM AYC200 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoAbilitMngList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN AS CHKLST_MNG_SN ,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,T1.PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,T2.CHKLST_GROUP_SN AS CHKLST_GROUP_SN ,(SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHKLST_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T2.CHKLST_SE_CD) AS CHKLST_SE_CD --체크리스트구분코드 ,T2.ABILIT_CN AS ABILIT_CN --역량내용 ,T2.ABILIT_ALLOT_SCORE AS ABILIT_ALLOT_SCORE --역량배점점수 ,T2.CRT_DT AS CRT_DT ,T2.CRT_ID AS CRT_ID ,T2.MDFCN_DT AS MDFCN_DT ,T2.MDFR_ID AS MDFR_ID ,T2.ADSBTR_SE_YN AS ADSBTR_SE_YN ,T2.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE FROM AYC250 T1 /* 체크리스트관리 */ ,AYC255 T2 /* 체크리스트그룹 */ ,AYC200 T3 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN = T2.CHKLST_MNG_SN AND T1.EVFO_MNG_SN = T3.EVFO_MNG_SN AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND T1.PRVSON_NM = #{PIVOT_COL} ORDER BY T2.CHKLST_GROUP_SN

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoCrtrMngList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN AS CHKLST_MNG_SN /* 체크리스트관리일련번호 */ ,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,T2.ABILIT_CN AS ABILIT_CN --역량내용 ,T4.CHKLST_SCORE AS CHKLST_SCORE ,T4.CHKLST_CN AS CHKLST_CN ,T4.QUEST_NO AS QUEST_NO ,T4.CHKLST_QUEST_SN AS CHKLST_QUEST_SN /* 체크리스트질의일련번호 */ ,T4.CHKLST_GROUP_SN AS CHKLST_GROUP_SN /* 체크리스트그룹일련번호 */ FROM AYC250 T1 /* 체크리스트관리 */ ,AYC255 T2 /* 체크리스트그룹 */ ,AYC200 T3 /* 평가지관리 */ ,AYC260 T4 /* 체크리스트질의 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN = T2.CHKLST_MNG_SN AND T1.EVFO_MNG_SN = T3.EVFO_MNG_SN AND T2.CHKLST_GROUP_SN= T4.CHKLST_GROUP_SN AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND T1.PRVSON_NM = #{PIVOT_COL} GROUP BY T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN,T2.ABILIT_CN,T4.CHKLST_SCORE,T4.CHKLST_CN,T4.QUEST_NO,T4.CHKLST_QUEST_SN,T4.CHKLST_GROUP_SN ORDER BY T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN, T4.CHKLST_GROUP_SN ASC, T4.CHKLST_SCORE DESC

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvlTrprMatchingList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
WITH VW_TAB AS ( SELECT LISTAGG(C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT),',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T1.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT ,T1.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN ,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,T1.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AS APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN FROM AYC230 T1 /* 평가대상관리 */ WHERE T1.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY T1.DEL_YN,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN,T1.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN ) SELECT a.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,a.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AS APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN ,a.APRAI_ID AS APRAI_ID ,C##RG.DEC_B64(a.APRAI_NM_ENCPT) AS APRAI_NM_ENCPT ,a.EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD AS EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD ,b.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT FROM AYC210 a /* 평가자관리상세 */ ,VW_TAB b /* 평가대상관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.EVFO_MNG_SN = b.EVFO_MNG_SN(+) AND a.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN(+) AND a.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND a.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY a.EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD,a.APRAI_ID

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvlTrprChcList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT a.EVL_TRPR_SLCTN_SN AS EVL_TRPR_SLCTN_SN ,a.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,a.CONSTT_ID AS CONSTT_ID ,C##RG.DEC_B64(c.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT ,d.EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD AS EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD ,d.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AS APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN ,DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYC230 x WHERE x.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND x.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = #{APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN} AND x.DEL_YN = 'N' AND x.CONSTT_ID = b.USER_ID ),1,'true','false') AS CHK FROM AYC240 a /* 평가대상자선정 */ ,SAA200 b /* 사용자 */ ,SCA100 c /* 종사자 */ ,AYC210 d WHERE 1=1 AND a.CONSTT_ID = b.USER_ID AND b.ENFSN_NO = c.ENFSN_NO AND a.EVFO_MNG_SN = d.EVFO_MNG_SN AND a.DEL_YN = 'N' AND c.DEL_YN = 'N' AND d.DEL_YN = 'N' AND d.EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL AND d.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = #{APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN}

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvlSeMngInqList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT a.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,a.RLVT_YR AS RLVT_YR ,a.EVL_TME_SE_CD AS EVL_TME_SE_CD ,b.EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD AS EVL_GROUP_TYPE_SE_CD ,b.APRAI_ID AS APRAI_ID ,C##RG.DEC_B64(b.APRAI_NM_ENCPT) AS APRAI_NM_ENCPT ,b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AS APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYC230 x WHERE x.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AND x.DEL_YN = 'N') AS NMPR ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYC230 x ,AYC280 y WHERE x.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AND x.EVL_TRGT_SN = y.EVL_TRGT_SN AND y.SRVY_KND_SE_CD = '01' AND x.DEL_YN = 'N' AND y.DEL_YN = 'N') AS OCNT1 ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYC230 x ,AYC280 y WHERE x.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AND x.EVL_TRGT_SN = y.EVL_TRGT_SN AND y.SRVY_KND_SE_CD = '02' AND x.DEL_YN = 'N' AND y.DEL_YN = 'N') AS OCNT2 ,(SELECT count(1) FROM AYC230 x ,AYC280 y WHERE x.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN = b.APRAI_MNG_DTL_SN AND x.EVL_TRGT_SN = y.EVL_TRGT_SN AND y.SRVY_KND_SE_CD = '03' AND x.DEL_YN = 'N' AND y.DEL_YN = 'N') AS OCNT3 FROM AYC200 a /* 평가지관리 */ ,AYC210 b /* 평가자관리상세 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.EVFO_MNG_SN = b.EVFO_MNG_SN AND a.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND a.DEL_YN = 'N' AND b.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY b.APRAI_NM_ENCPT

/* isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.DscsnAbilitMngMapper.selectEvfoAbilitUpdate - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN AS CHKLST_MNG_SN ,T1.EVFO_MNG_SN AS EVFO_MNG_SN ,T1.PRVSON_NM AS PRVSON_NM ,T2.CHKLST_GROUP_SN AS CHKLST_GROUP_SN ,T2.CHKLST_SE_CD AS CHKLST_SE_CD --체크리스트구분코드 ,T2.ABILIT_CN AS ABILIT_CN --역량내용 ,T2.ABILIT_ALLOT_SCORE AS ABILIT_ALLOT_SCORE --역량배점점수 ,T2.CRT_DT AS CRT_DT ,T2.CRT_ID AS CRT_ID ,T2.MDFCN_DT AS MDFCN_DT ,T2.MDFR_ID AS MDFR_ID ,T2.ADSBTR_SE_YN AS ADSBTR_SE_YN ,T2.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE ,T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN AS CHKLST_MNG_SN FROM AYC250 T1 /* 체크리스트관리 */ ,AYC255 T2 /* 체크리스트그룹 */ ,AYC200 T3 /* 평가지관리 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN = T2.CHKLST_MNG_SN AND T1.EVFO_MNG_SN = T3.EVFO_MNG_SN AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T3.EVFO_MNG_SN = #{EVFO_MNG_SN} AND T1.CHKLST_MNG_SN = #{CHKLST_MNG_SN}
